long_biography.plain_text:
Architect Chris Lessard pledged his own professional services to secure a loan from friends when he restarted his practice. Having already established one firm after running a regional office for the Martin Architectural Group, he needed fresh capital for the next venture. The resulting business grew beyond its Washington base, adding international design work and specialist teams.

Lessard's housing designs respond to how people use limited space. For compact lots, he has placed bedrooms above garages and converted attic space into studies or extra rooms, preserving useful accommodation without enlarging the footprint. Within his firm, he encourages senior designers to research new approaches and take creative responsibility, making collaboration part of the practice's development.
